map.预调查阶段判断自编量表的条目能否稳定测量同一概念，决定是否需要删题或补充条目。: At the pre-survey stage, judge whether the self-designed scale items can stably measure the same concept, deciding whether to delete or add items.

map.对问卷的各维度分别计算，逐个维度检查是否都达到可接受的 α 水平。: Compute each dimension of the questionnaire separately, and check dimension by dimension whether all reach an acceptable α level.
map.6 名被试、5 个条目，条目方差合计 3.50，总分方差 13.56。α = 5: 6 respondents, 5 items, total item variance 3.50, total score variance 13.56. α = 5 ÷ 4 × (1 − 3.50 ÷ 13.56) = 1.25 × 0.7418 = 0.927, judged as "excellent reliability".
map.若算得 α = 0.58，常见原因是某个条目与其他条目方向相反或未反向计分。先把: If alpha = 0.58 is computed, the common cause is an item with opposite direction or not reverse-scored. First unify the direction of reverse items then recompute; if still low, delete items weakly correlated with others, or add synonymous items to raise inter-item covariance.
map.条目数对 α 的影响: Effect of item count on α
map.α 随条目数增加而升高，8 个条目的量表往往比 3 个条目的更容易达到 0.80: Alpha rises with more items; an 8-item scale is often easier to reach 0.80 than a 3-item one. Thus in a short scale a slightly lower alpha (e.g. 0.65) is not necessarily unusable; report the item count alongside so readers can judge.
map.学界常用门槛是 0.70 以上可接受，0.80 以上良好，0.90 以上优秀；探: The common academic threshold: ≥0.70 acceptable, ≥0.80 good, ≥0.90 excellent; in exploratory research or with very few items, 0.60 can be marginally used. Excessively high alpha (e.g. above 0.95) instead signals item redundancy, possibly near-duplicate items.
map.α 高就说明量表有效吗？: Does high α mean the scale is valid?
map.不能。α 只反映条目之间的一致性，属于信度，不证明量表测到了构念。效度需要另外的: No. Alpha only reflects inter-item consistency, which is reliability, and does not prove the scale measures the construct. Validity needs separate evidence of content validity, construct validity (e.g. factor analysis) and criterion-related validity.
map.数据录进去报错怎么办？: What if data entry errors out?
map.要求每行一名被试、每行列数相同且至少 2 列。若某行列数与首行不一致，工具会提示: Requires one respondent per row, same column count per row and at least 2 columns. If a row column count differs from the first, the tool prompts and refuses to calculate; for missing data, first handle per the scale manual (e.g. series mean substitution or whole-record removal), do not leave blanks.
